name: mdx-forge-outcome-record-contract
purpose: Define the first learning-loop outcome object: a completed or in-flight Forge run folded into evidence that Learn can review before any behavior changes.
state_rules: running runs are observable but not promotable
done runs with passing checks may become candidate lessons after human judgment
done runs without checks remain not promotable until evaluation evidence exists
failed or stopped runs can teach failure patterns, but cannot reduce review depth
no outcome record may change model routing, fleet casting, check policy, budget, or review depth in v0
